answers.how: Fitting the nest’s fall gives about 2200 px/s², setting the gravity-based scale. Correcting to the bird’s depth gives about 0.031 m/px. Its motion near 1 s is about 215 px/s; including the depth change gives approximately 6.9 m/s.
The bird’s beak-to-tail length near 1 s is about 52 px. The gravity-derived scale, corrected to its depth, is about 0.031 m/px, giving 1.6 m.
The wheel’s vertical diameter is about 84 px. Correcting the gravity-derived nest scale to the cart’s depth gives about 0.024 m/px, yielding 2.0 m.
